other_failure_modes.name: In-sample target encoding leak
other_failure_modes.description: Target encoding statistics are computed on the training set and applied directly to those same training instances without using an out-of-fold or leave-one-out strategy, which causes tree-based models to overfit to the exact group target means.

summary: The agent creates a sophisticated predictive pipeline including domain-specific feature engineering, a deep learning model, and cross-validated meta-stacking. However, it completely ignores foundational data cleaning steps. More critically, the agent introduces an in-sample target encoding leak inside the CV folds, which severely harms the models' generalization by causing them to overfit to the training set's group target means.
